macros.name: Chi
macros.doc: The glossaries-extra-bib2gls package also provides definitions of the missing mathematical Greek commands: \Alpha, \Beta, \Epsilon, \Zeta, \Eta, \Iota, \Kappa, \Mu, \Nu, \Omicron, \Rho, \Tau, \Chi, \Digamma, \omicron.

macros.name: dgls
macros.doc: Like \gls but tries the prefixes.

macros.name: dglsdisp
macros.doc: Like \glsdisp but tries the prefixes.

macros.name: dGlsfield
macros.doc: As \dglsfield but applies sentence case.

macros.name: dglsfieldactualfieldlabel
macros.doc: This is the field that’s actually used.

macros.name: dglsfieldcurrentfieldlabel
macros.doc: Set by the \dglsfield commands to the current field label.

macros.name: dglsfieldfallbackfieldlabel
macros.doc: The field to use if the required field isn’t set.

macros.name: dglslink
macros.doc: Like \glslink but tries the prefixes.

macros.name: Digamma
macros.doc: Defined with \providecommand, this just does \mathrm{F}.

macros.name: glsxtraddlabelprefix
macros.doc: Add prefix to the list.

macros.name: glsxtrBasicDigitrules
macros.doc: Digits from the Basic Latin set.

macros.name: GlsXtrBibTeXEntryAliases
macros.doc: This provides aliases for BibTeX’s standard entry types (such as @article and @book) to bib2gls’s @bibtexentry entry type (requires bib2gls v1.4+).

macros.name: glsxtrclearlabelprefixes
macros.doc: Clears the list of known prefixes.

macros.name: glsxtrcombiningdiacriticIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the second set of combining diacritic sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrcombiningdiacriticIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the first set of combining diacritic sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrcombiningdiacriticrules
macros.doc: Expands to all the combining diacritic sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrcontrolIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the ordered set of “information separator” control codes 1C, 1D, 1E, and 1F.

macros.name: glsxtrcontrolIrules
macros.doc: Subset of control rules.

macros.name: glsxtrcontrolrules
macros.doc: Expands to control character sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrdisplaylocnameref
macros.doc: If hyperref has been loaded, then \glsxtrdisplaylocnameref will try to work out the appropriate hyperlink anchor and text.

macros.name: glsxtrdisplaysupploc
macros.doc: This is like \glsnoidxdisplayloc but is used for supplementary locations and so requires an extra argument.

macros.name: GlsXtrDualField
macros.doc: The internal field used to store the dual label.

macros.name: glsxtrfractionrules
macros.doc: This rule block contains vulgar fraction characters from the Unicode Number Forms block.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinAtoGrules
macros.doc: Expands to the A–G subset of General Latin I sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinAtoMrules
macros.doc: Basic Latin alphabet A–M.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinHtoMrules
macros.doc: Expands to the H–M subset of General Latin I sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinIIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the third set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the second set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the first set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinIVrules
macros.doc: Expands to the fourth set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinNtoSrules
macros.doc: Expands to the N–S subset of General Latin I sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinNtoZrules
macros.doc: Expands to the N–Z subset of General Latin I sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinVIIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the eighth set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinVIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the seventh set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinVIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the sixth set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralLatinVrules
macros.doc: Expands to the fifth set of General Latin sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncaccentsrules
macros.doc: Punctuation accent subset of \glsxtrgeneralpuncIrules.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncbracketIIrules
macros.doc: Second punctuation bracket subset (mathematical brackets).

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncbracketIVrules
macros.doc: Fourth punctuation bracket subset (ornamental brackets).

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncbracketrules
macros.doc: By default this just expands to the first subset of bracket rules \glsxtrgeneralpuncbracketIrules but may be redefined to include extra sets.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncIIIrules
macros.doc: An alternative to \glsxtrgeneralpuncIIrules, this sub-block includes \glsxtrhyphenIIrules and \glsxtrminusrules between the percent and plus signs.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the first set of general punctuation (including currency) sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncmarksrules
macros.doc: Punctuation marks subset.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncquoterules
macros.doc: Punctuation marks subset: quotes.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncrules
macros.doc: This contains punctuation characters.

macros.name: glsxtrGeneralPuncRules
macros.doc: A shortcut command for common punctuation and digits.

macros.name: glsxtrgeneralpuncsignrules
macros.doc: Punctuation sign subset of \glsxtrgeneralpuncIrules.

macros.name: glsxtrhyphenIIrules
macros.doc: An alternative to the first set of hyphen rules, this set has the same characters but lists them in ascending order.

macros.name: glsxtrhyphenIrules
macros.doc: This first set consists of: ASCII hyphen/minus, soft hyphen, non-breaking hyphen, figure dash, en dash, em dash and horizontal bar, which are all considered equivalent.

macros.name: glsxtrhyphenrules
macros.doc: This contains hyphens (including the minus sign 0x2212).

macros.name: GlsXtrIfHasNonZeroChildCount
macros.doc: A shortcut that uses \GlsXtrIfFieldNonZero to test if the value supplied in the childcount field is non-zero.

macros.name: glsxtrifinlabelprefixlist
macros.doc: Test if the given prefix is in the list.

macros.name: GlsXtrIndexCounterLink
macros.doc: This command creates a hyperlink (if supported) to the target obtained from the indexcounter field (which will be set in the glstex file, if applicable).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinAA
macros.doc: A mini-rule for “a with ring above” (Å, å) so you don’t need to remember the Unicode values.

macros.name: glsxtrLatinAELigature
macros.doc: A mini-rule for ae-ligature (Æ, æ) so you don’t need to remember the Unicode values.

macros.name: glsxtrLatinE
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin E (includes 0x2091).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinH
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin H (includes 0x2095).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinK
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin K (includes 0x2096).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinM
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin M (includes 0x2098).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinO
macros.doc: A mini-rule that just covers “O” but includes the sub- and superscript O.

macros.name: glsxtrLatinOslash
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin ø.

macros.name: glsxtrLatinP
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin P (includes 0x209A).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinT
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin T (includes 0x209C).

macros.name: glsxtrLatinWynn
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin wynn.

macros.name: glsxtrLatinX
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of Latin X (includes 0x2093).

macros.name: glsxtrMathGreekIrules
macros.doc: Includes both upright and italic with digamma between epsilon and zeta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicAlpha
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek alpha.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicBeta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek beta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicChi
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek chi.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicDelta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek delta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicGamma
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek gamma.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicGreekIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the first set of math italic Greek sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicIota
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek iota.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicKappa
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek kappa.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicLambda
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek lambda.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicLowerGreekIIrules
macros.doc: A rule block for lower case mathematical Greek (\alpha, \beta, etc) characters that doesn’t include digamma.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicLowerGreekIrules
macros.doc: A rule block for lowercase mathematical Greek (\alpha, \beta, etc) characters that includes digamma (\digamma) between epsilon and zeta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicNabla
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the Unicode codepoint for nabla.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicNu
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek nu.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicOmega
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek omega.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicPsi
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek psi.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicRho
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek rho.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicSigma
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek sigma.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicTau
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek tau.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicTheta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek theta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicUpperGreekIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the second set of math italic uppercase Greek sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrMathItalicZeta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math italic Greek zeta.

macros.name: glsxtrMathUpGreekIIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the second set of math upright Greek sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrMathUpGreekIrules
macros.doc: Expands to the first set of math upright Greek sort rules.

macros.name: glsxtrmultientryadjustednamefmt
macros.doc: This just does its argument by default.

macros.name: GlsXtrmultientryadjustednamefmt
macros.doc: This uses \glscapitalisewords, if defined, or \capitalisewords otherwise.

macros.name: GLSxtrmultientryadjustednamefmt
macros.doc: This uses \mfirstucMakeUppercase by default.

macros.name: glsxtrnameloclink
macros.doc: Like \@gls@numberlink, this creates a hyperlink to the target obtained from the prefix, counter and location but uses ⟨text⟩ as the hyperlink text.

macros.name: glsxtrnonprintablerules
macros.doc: These are non-printable characters (BOM, tabs, line feed and carriage return).

macros.name: GlsXtrResourceInitEscSequences
macros.doc: This command locally redefines escape sequences used in regular expressions so that they detokenize when they expand.

macros.name: glsxtrsetactualanchor
macros.doc: Hook used by \glsxtrdisplaylocnameref to override the default definition of \glsxtractualanchor.

macros.name: glsxtrUpDelta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright delta.

macros.name: glsxtrUpGamma
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright gamma.

macros.name: glsxtrUpKappa
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright kappa.

macros.name: glsxtrUpNu
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright nu.

macros.name: glsxtrUpPi
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright pi.

macros.name: glsxtrUpPsi
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright psi.

macros.name: glsxtrUpRho
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright rho.

macros.name: glsxtrUpSigma
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright sigma.

macros.name: glsxtrUpZeta
macros.doc: (Sort rule) expands to the variations of math Greek upright zeta.

macros.name: predglsfieldhook
macros.doc: Hook for use at the start of the \dglsfield-like commands.

macros.name: predglshook
macros.doc: Hook for use at the start of the \dgls-like commands.

macros.name: predglslinkhook
macros.doc: Hook for use at the start of the \dglslink and \dglsdisp.
